section_sequence.what_it_does: Thin black bar: R mark, 5 uppercase links left, Docs + dark 'Get started' button right; stays fixed through the scroll.

Asymmetric split: narrow left column of labeled use-case video cards (Product UI, Game UI, Mobile apps, Film + TV, Websites) beside a wide right column with wordmark, wide display H1, grey lede, a CLI install/editor panel and a one-line trust sentence.
Lighter charcoal band; small orange eyebrow + H2 + short copy + two ghost buttons on the left, large editor screenshot (fighting-game UI) on the right.
Mirrored split on black: 5x3 grid of platform/framework logos left, eyebrow + H2 + two paragraphs + buttons right.
Centered two-line H2 claim (2 billion users), two rows of monochrome client logos, then a centered paragraph.
3-column grid of ~18 tweet-style quote cards with avatar, name, handle, text.
Left-aligned heading + one line of copy, email field and Sign up button on the right.
Six link columns (Product, Community, Learn, Company, Use cases, Case studies), then wordmark, copyright and social icons.

motion.observed: Left card column drifts vertically and each card's video changes (clock face, game UI, mobile-app screens) across every intro frame through t=8s; it has not settled by 8s.
At t=0 of the recording the card column is blank; cards and videos fill in over the first ~1s.
Headline, CLI panel and copy are static across all intro frames; no text entrance animation seen.
Sections appear already composed as they enter; no visible reveal/fade in the sampled frames.

reduced_motion: Layout identical; card column still shows moving/changed video frames (different cards visible than in normal hero), so the autoplay video column is not visibly disabled. capture.json running_animations = 0 in both normal and reduced (motion is video/canvas, not CSS/WAAPI).
mobile: Header stays pinned as R mark + hamburger + 'Get started' through the whole scroll strip. The vertical card column becomes a horizontal peeking carousel ABOVE the wordmark/H1; hero copy, CLI panel and buttons ('Downloads' replaces 'Download desktop app') stack full-width. Editor section puts copy and buttons above the screenshot; runtimes puts copy/buttons above the logo grid. Testimonials go single-column (long run), newsletter stacks field under copy, footer link groups become 2 columns.
adaptable_ideas: Hero as proof-of-capability: a narrow (~1/4 width) live-media rail of labeled use cases beside the headline, so the product demos itself before any copy is read.
Put the first real action (install command with OS tabs + copy button) inside the hero, framed as a quiet panel rather than a big CTA button.
Alternate text/media sides across consecutive feature bands and shift the band tone (black vs charcoal) to separate them without dividers.
Pair a wide geometric display face for H1/H2 with a small uppercase coloured eyebrow and plain grotesk body; keep all heading sizes modest except the hero.
